t.home_page_title like CONCAT( CONCAT('%',#{homePageTitle} ),'%')
and t.function_name like CONCAT( CONCAT('%',#{functionName} ),'%')
and t.status = #{status}
select user_id from sys_home_page_component_user where component_id = #{componentId}

select component_id,home_page_title,function_name,function_code,refresh_rate,loading_type,user_type,remarks, status,show_status,function_url,create_date,create_by from sys_home_page_component_user t1 inner join sys_home_page_component t on t1.component_id = t.component_id where t.loading_type= '2' and t1.user_id = #{userId}
